case_frames.definition: Verb valency specifications in Japanese are governed by strict particle-case grids rather than surface linear position.

frames.example: 太郎が花子に手紙を渡した。
田中さんが東京に住んでいる。
鈴木さんが工場で働く。

sub_lexical_kanji_embeddings.architecture: Decomposes Kanji compounds into constituent ideogram embeddings and radicals (Bushu 部首) to infer the semantic category of out-of-vocabulary neologisms.

thematic_roles_stability.observation: Because Japanese allows extensive constituent scrambling, thematic roles are securely anchored to particle markers: が consistently signals Agent/Experiencer, を signals Patient/Theme, に signals Goal/Recipient/Time, and で signals Instrument/Dynamic Action Location.
